packageRules.description: Every update type merges unattended, majors included. GitHub auto-merge waits for the branch ruleset's required ci-ok check, which needs checks, commitlint and validate to pass.

A plugin pin moves only to an upstream release or commit at least 7 days old. strict holds a younger one back entirely rather than proposing it early. Scoped to the regex managers so GitHub Actions, which also resolve through github-tags, keep their own cadence.

customManagers.description: A tag-pinned plugin: one manager owns both the manifest pin (ref and sha) and the README table row, so a single branch carries both edits and the README sync check never sees them split across PRs.

A branch-pinned plugin follows the head of main. Same pairing as the tag manager: the manifest sha and the README row move in one branch. The README holds the full sha because Renovate writes a new digest at full length.
Pins the Claude Code CLI version that CI installs, from the renovate comment above CLAUDE_CODE_VERSION.
